title: The same title belongs to a different lens
request: It is 2026-10-28 at 12:00 UTC. The seller says the lens I shortlisted is back under a new listing. Is my previous recommendation still valid? I have a Vale R-mount camera, need direct compatibility without an adapter, and have an inclusive 800.00 SEK delivered maximum. Compare the supplied records.

evidence.text: All products and records here are fictional. Vale V50R fits Vale R-mount cameras directly. Vale V50S uses the different S mount and cannot attach directly to the buyer’s R-mount camera. The shared 50 mm focal length and title do not identify the mount.
Earlier listing L100, titled Vale 50mm lens, identified model V50R, unit serial SYN-R-100, at 700.00 SEK delivered including all fees. L100 is now sold.
I inspected unit SYN-R-100 two days ago, confirmed its R mount on my camera and saw working autofocus with clean glass. I have not handled the newly listed unit.

New listing L200 has the same title, Vale 50mm lens, but its current description and supplied model-label image identify V50S, serial SYN-S-200. Seller says it is the same kind of lens as before and asks 650.00 SEK delivered including all fees. No inspection of this unit is supplied.
L200 is active in the current synthetic snapshot.

hard_failures.text: Carries over the old unit’s compatibility or inspected condition to L200 despite the changed model and serial.
Recommends L200 as directly compatible because its title, brand or focal length matches the old listing, or silently introduces an adapter contrary to the buyer’s requirement.

usefulness.text: Identifies the new listing as a different unit and mount, while separating its 650.00 SEK budget fit from its failed compatibility requirement.
Explains which earlier evidence remains model knowledge and which unit-specific inspection cannot transfer.
Withdraws the old recommendation and suggests looking for an actual V50R or another documented R-mount option within budget.

acceptable_outcomes: Reject L200 for this buyer’s direct-fit requirement; the old inspected unit is sold and its condition findings do not apply to the new listing.
